data.one_liner: An action bottom sheet that adapts to the platform between Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: Provides a platform-adaptive action bottom sheet widget that renders as a Material bottom sheet on Android and a Cupertino action sheet on iOS. Allows passing actions with leading and trailing widgets, a cancel action, a title, and styling options.
use_when: You need to display action sheets that follow platform conventions on both Android and iOS.
You want to replace standard modal bottom sheets with a structured action list and optional cancel button.
avoid_when: You require a completely custom non-native bottom sheet design across all platforms.
You need complex multi-page bottom sheet flows.
strengths: Automatically adapts UI to Android and iOS platform conventions.
Supports leading and trailing widgets for action items.
Easy integration with standard Flutter context and builder functions.
weaknesses: Limited to bottom sheet action use cases.
Styling customization is constrained by native platform design patterns.

alternatives.name: adaptive_dialog
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need platform-adaptive dialogs in addition to bottom sheets.

alternatives.name: adaptive_platform_ui
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you are looking for a broader set of platform-adaptive UI components.

data.minimal_example:
showAdaptiveActionSheet(
 context: context,
 title: const Text('Title'),
 androidBorderRadius: 30,
 actions: <BottomSheetAction>[
    BottomSheetAction(title: const Text('Item 1'), onPressed: (context) {}),
    BottomSheetAction(title: const Text('Item 2'), onPressed: (context) {}),
    BottomSheetAction(title: const Text('Item 3'), onPressed: (context) {}),
 ],
 cancelAction: CancelAction(title: const Text('Cancel')),
);
